205100.name: At The Adamantium Gates

north.description: To the north lies The City Street Outside The Adamantium gates.

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel Of Ornate Arches.

205100.description:
The adamantium gates loom over this guardroom, two vast leaves of grey
metal so heavy that only magic could swing them. Their inner faces are
engraved with a warning in the drow tongue that runs from top to bottom
in tall, angular script. Murder holes pierce the ceiling, and the stone
floor is marked with grooves where the gates have turned. The gates open
north into the city, while a passage leads east into the Tunnel of
Ornate Arches.

extra_descs.warning script engraving inscription:
The angular drow script reads, roughly: Who enters without leave of the
Houses feeds the Spider. Beneath it the metal is scored with old
scratches, as if someone once tried to tear at it with bare hands.

205101.name: The City Street Outside The Adamantium gates

east.description: To the east lies City Street.

south.description: To the south lies At The Adamantium Gates.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend In The City Street.

205101.description:
The street broadens before the city's great adamantium gates, which
stand to the south in a wall of black stone cut sheer from the cavern.
Spikes of grey metal crown the gatehouse, and a lantern of faerie fire
burns above the arch. The street runs east past a large building and
west to a bend by the fungus forest. Everything here is built to be
defended, and nothing is built to welcome.

5102.name: The City Street
5102.description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street going north and west. Dust
motes drift in the stale air. The air is still and musty. The air is
stale and the walls close. Shadows pool in the corners, undisturbed.

north.description: To the north lies The City Street.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The City Street.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Dwelling In The Stalagmite.

5103.name: The City Street
5103.description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street going east-west. A large
house stands to the south. The ceiling hangs low overhead. Shadows
gather in the corners.

north.description: To the north lies A Bend In The City Street.

east.description: To the east lies A Small Dwelling In The Stalagmite.

south.description: To the south lies The City Street.

205104.name: The Main Chamber In The Third House

up.description: To the up lies The Third Throne.

down.description: To the down lies The Entrance To The Third House.

205104.description:
This broad chamber fills the hollow heart of the stalagmite, its ceiling
vaulted into a point far overhead. Tapestries woven of grey spider silk
hang between narrow windows, showing hunts and sacrifices in threads of
dull silver. Low couches of dark wood and cushions of violet velvet
stand in a ring about a cold brazier. A curving stair climbs on up
toward the throne room, and another winds down to the entrance.

205105.name: The Third Throne

down.description: To the down lies The Main Chamber In The Third House.

205105.description:
The throne room of the Third House sits near the very tip of the
stalagmite, a round chamber whose walls taper to a point overhead. The
throne itself is carved from a single block of obsidian, its tall back
worked into the shape of a spider's spread legs. Faerie fire burns in a
ring of silver bowls set into the floor, washing everything in cold
purple light. Narrow windows look out over the dark city, and the only
way out is the stair winding down.

5106.name: City Street
5106.description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street going east-west. To the north
is a large building. The walls are rough-hewn and cold to the touch. The
air is still and musty.

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The City Street.

south.description: To the south lies A Slave Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The City Street Outside The Adamantium gates.

5107.name: The City Street
5107.description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street leading north and east. To
the south is an extremely large house. The ceiling hangs low overhead.
The walls are rough-hewn and cold to the touch.

north.description: A passage leads to The Main Gate

east.description: To the east lies The Warriors' Academy.

south.description: To the south lies The City Street.

205108.name: The Main Chamber In The Second House

up.description: To the up lies The Second Throne.

down.description: To the down lies The Entrance To The Second House.

205108.description:
Three galleries open into this tall chamber, one from each of the joined
spires, and slender bridges of stone cross the air between them. Beneath
them the floor is a single vast mosaic of a spider descending on a
thread toward a kneeling figure. Long tables of black wood stand along
the walls, set with silver goblets and plates turned face down. A stair
climbs higher toward the throne, and another goes down to the entrance
hall.

205109.name: The Second Throne

down.description: To the down lies The Main Chamber In The Second House.

205109.description:
The Second Throne stands on a dais of three steps, a seat of grey
adamantite padded with black silk and crowned with a fan of iron spider
legs. Behind it a window of smoky crystal gives a view across the whole
cavern, where the lights of the city glimmer like scattered embers. The
air is cool and faintly scented with a bitter incense. A stair spirals
down to the main chamber of the house.

5101.name: A Bend In The City Street
5101.description:
You walk along a highly ornate street going north-south. A large gate
lies to the east while a building lies to the west. The air is still and
musty. Dust motes drift in the stale air.

north.description: A passage leads to A City Street

west.description: To the west lies City Street.

up.description: To the up lies A Giant Cave.

205111.name: The Main Chamber Of The First House

up.description: To the up lies Before The Chamber Of The First Matron Mother.

down.description: To the down lies The Entrance To The First House.

205111.description:
This is the grandest hall in the city, a vast space hollowed from the
heart of the largest stalagmite. Hundreds of tiny lights of faerie fire
hang in the air beneath the vault like a field of violet stars. The
walls are carved in deep relief with the long history of the house,
battle after battle and sacrifice after sacrifice. A narrow stair climbs
higher toward the Matron Mother's chamber, and the grand stair descends
to the entrance.

205112.name: Before The Chamber Of The First Matron Mother

north.description: To the north lies The First Throne.

down.description: To the down lies The Main Chamber Of The First House.

205112.description:
A short landing of black marble ends before a tall door of dark wood
bound in silver, set in the wall to the north. Its panels are carved
with a great spider whose legs reach out to the edges of the frame, and
its eyes are two cut amethysts that seem to follow anyone who
approaches. Twin braziers burn with a low purple flame on either side.
The stair winds back down to the main chamber.

extra_descs.door spider amethysts eyes:
The carved spider covers the whole door, its legs curling round the
silver bands. Its two amethyst eyes catch the brazier light, and from
any part of the landing they seem to be looking straight at you.

205113.name: The First Throne

east.description: To the east lies An Ornate Walkway High Above The City.

south.description: To the south lies Before The Chamber Of The First Matron Mother.

205113.description:
The throne room of the First Matron Mother is a long hall of black stone
ribbed with silver, rising to a pointed vault far overhead. The throne
of obsidian and bone stands on a high dais, flanked by bowls of violet
flame and draped in webs of pale silk. A narrow door in the east wall
opens onto a walkway high above the city. The way back lies through the
door to the south.

5114.name: A Bend In The City Street
5114.description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street leading north-south and east.
The air is still and musty. The walls are rough-hewn and cold to the
touch.

east.description: A passage leads to A City Street

south.description: To the south lies The City Street.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Dwelling In The Stalagmite.

205115.name: The City Street Outside The Third House

north.description: To the north lies The Entrance To The Third House.

west.description: To the west lies A Junction In The City Street.

205115.description:
A tall stalagmite rises from the cavern floor here, hollowed and carved
into the many-windowed fortress of the Third House. Its doorway opens to
the north, framed by two pillars shaped as rearing spiders with their
legs locked overhead. Thin lines of violet faerie fire trace the edges
of every balcony and window, so the whole spire glows faintly against
the dark. The street turns back west to the junction.

5120.name: The Mages' Academy
5120.description:
The Mages' Academy is fairly well decorated and Visible is that the drow
prefer magic over physical power greatly. The walls are rough-hewn and
cold to the touch. The air is still and musty.

west.description: To the west lies The City Street Outside The Fourth House.

5117.name: The City Street
5117.description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street going east-west. To the north
is a giant temple. The ceiling hangs low overhead. The walls are rough-
hewn and cold to the touch.

north.description: To the north lies The Assassins' Academy.

east.description: A passage leads to A City Street

west.description: A passage leads to A City Street

south.description: To the south lies A City Street.

5118.name: The Warriors' Academy
5118.description:
The Warriors' Academy fills this vast cavern with the sounds of combat
training. Drow fighters practice deadly techniques under the watchful
eyes of weapon masters, their movements fluid and precise in the dim
faerie fire light. The ceiling hangs low overhead. Shadows gather in the
corners.

west.description: To the west lies The City Street.

5119.name: Entrance To The Temple Of Lloth
5119.description:
The temple is the largest building in the city. Even its doors are
beyond imagination. Inside of the temple entrance, the walls are made of
gold and adamantite. Shadows gather in the corners. The air is still and
musty.

west.description: To the west lies An Ornate Walkway High Above The City.

up.description: To the up lies Entranceway To The Temple Of Lloth.

205120.name: The Assassins' Academy

south.description: To the south lies The City Street.

205120.description:
The Assassins' Academy is a long, dim hall with no windows, its walls
hung with black drapes that swallow every sound. Practice dummies of
stitched leather stand in a row, slashed and pierced a hundred times
over, and a narrow beam runs the length of the floor at knee height for
training balance. The lamps of fungus are shuttered almost closed. The
only door opens south onto the city street before the temple.

5121.name: The City Street
5121.description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street going eastward. To the north
is a building. The ceiling hangs low overhead. The air is still and
musty.

east.description: To the east lies The Center Of The Drow City.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Dwelling In The Stalagmite.

west.description: A passage leads to A City Street

5122.name: A Slave Chamber
5122.description:
The room is in shambles. Straw is strewn all about the room as beds for
the unfortunate creatures who have fallen prey to drow imperialism. Dust
motes drift in the stale air. The walls are rough-hewn and cold to the
touch.

north.description: To the north lies City Street.

5123.name: The City Street
5123.description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street leading west and south. To
the north is a relatively small house. The walls are rough-hewn and cold
to the touch. The air is still and musty.

north.description: To the north lies The City Street.

south.description: A passage leads to A City Street

west.description: To the west lies A Small Dwelling In The Stalactite.

205124.name: The Main Chamber In The Fourth house

up.description: To the up lies The Fourth Throne.

down.description: To the down lies The Entrance To The Fourth House.

205124.description:
The main chamber of the Fourth House is plainer than those of its
rivals, a round hall lined with weapon racks and hung with battle
standards torn in old wars. A long table of black stone bears a carved
map of the cavern, its houses marked with chips of coloured crystal. The
stair climbs on up to the throne and winds down again to the entrance.
Everything smells faintly of oil and steel.

205125.name: The Fourth Throne

down.description: To the down lies The Main Chamber In The Fourth house.

205125.description:
The Fourth Throne is a hard seat of grey stone, set on a plain dais and
flanked by two tall shields bearing the house's spider and dagger. The
chamber is small, its walls bare but for a long crack in the rock that
has been carefully filled with silver. A narrow window gives on the dark
city, the great temple's spires just visible far off. The stair spirals
back down to the main chamber.

5126.name: Entranceway To The Temple Of Lloth
5126.description:
The area opens in the entrance way to the temple which opens up to the
north into a large hallway going east and west. Small statues os spiders
line the entrance way's walls. Dust motes drift in the stale air.
Shadows gather in the corners.

north.description: A passage leads to A Hallway

down.description: To the down lies Entrance To The Temple Of Lloth.

5127.name: A Hallway
5127.description:
This is a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved
with pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west.
As you look down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving
away from you. To the north is a obsidian stairway. Shadows gather in
the corners. The air is still and musty.

north.description: A passage leads to The Grand Stairway

south.description: A passage leads to The Entrance Hall

west.description: A passage leads to A Long Hallway

5128.name: A Long Hallway
5128.description:
This is a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved
with pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west.
As you look down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving
away from you. The ceiling hangs low overhead. The walls are rough-hewn
and cold to the touch.

east.description: A passage leads to A Long Hallway

5129.name: A Long Hallway
5129.description:
This is a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved
with pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west.
As you look down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving
away from you. To the north is a door. Shadows gather in the corners.
The ceiling hangs low overhead.

east.description: A passage leads to A Long Hallway

west.description: A passage leads to A Long Hallway

5130.name: A Long Hallway
5130.description:
This is a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved
with pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west.
As you look down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving
away from you. The ceiling hangs low overhead. The air is still and
musty.

east.description: A passage leads to A Long Hallway

west.description: A passage leads to A Long Hallway

5131.name: A Long Hallway
5131.description:
This is a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved
with pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west.
As you look down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving
away from you. The ceiling hangs low overhead. Dust motes drift in the
stale air.

east.description: A passage leads to A Hallway

west.description: A passage leads to A Long Hallway

5132.name: A Long Hallway
5132.description:
This is a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved
with pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west.
As you look down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving
away from you. To the south is a door. Shadows gather in the corners.
The ceiling hangs low overhead.

east.description: A passage leads to A Long Hallway

south.description: A passage leads to The Warriors' Barracks

west.description: A passage leads to A Long Hallway

5133.name: The Warrior's Barracks
5133.description:
The room is a complete mess. None of the beds are made, clothes and
other items have been left all about the room. Well drow warriors never
were known for neatness. Shadows gather in the corners. The ceiling
hangs low overhead.

north.description: To the north lies A Long Hallway.

5134.name: A Long Hallway
5134.description:
This is a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved
with pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west.
As you look down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving
away from you. The walls are rough-hewn and cold to the touch. The air
is still and musty.

east.description: A passage leads to A Long Hallway

west.description: A passage leads to A Long Hallway

5135.name: The Grand Stairway
5135.description:
The area opens at the bottom of a giant obsidian and adamantite
stairway. The edges are trimmed with gold. The ceiling hangs low
overhead. The air is still and musty.

south.description: A passage leads to A Hallway

up.description: A passage leads to The Grand Hallway

5136.name: The Grand Hallway
5136.description:
This is the middle of a grand hallway. The walls are of the purest
adamantite with gold trim. Mosaics line the walls. Shadows gather in the
corners. The air is still and musty.

north.description: A passage leads to The Grand Hallway

east.description: A passage leads to The Mages' Barracks

down.description: A passage leads to The Grand Stairway

5137.name: The Mages' Barracks
5137.description:
The mage's living quarters is rather clean with the exception of a few
used component containers. It is rather well decorated as well. Cots
line the floor for the mages to sleep on. The only door is to the west.
The walls are rough-hewn and cold to the touch. Dust motes drift in the
stale air.

west.description: A passage leads to The Grand Hallway

5138.name: The Grand Hallway
5138.description:
The way continues down a grand hallway, heavily decorated with
adamantite and gold. To the north the hall goes down a flight of stairs
while a door is to the west. Shadows gather in the corners. Dust motes
drift in the stale air.

south.description: A passage leads to The Grand Hallway

west.description: A passage leads to The Clerics' Barracks

up.description: To the up lies The Grand Stairway.

5139.name: The Clerics' Barracks
5139.description:
The bed chamber is brightly decorated with spider shaped statues, murals
and the like. Large beds line the floor making this a comfortable room
to live in. The air is still and musty. The walls are rough-hewn and
cold to the touch.

east.description: A passage leads to The Grand Hallway

5140.name: The Grand Stairway
5140.description:
The area is climbing a set of obsidian stairs surrounded by adamantite
walls. To the north are a set of large golden doors. Shadows gather in
the corners. The walls are rough-hewn and cold to the touch.

north.description: A passage leads to The Main Chamber

down.description: To the down lies The Grand Hallway.

5141.name: The Grand Temple Of Lloth

east.description: To the east lies Slave Cells.

south.description: A passage leads to The Grand Stairway

5141.description:
The Grand Temple of Lloth opens out in a vast hall of black stone, its
ceiling hidden in shadow and hung with thick curtains of web. Pillars
carved as the legs of a colossal spider rise in two rows toward the
dark, their tips glinting with silver. The golden doors to the south
lead out onto the grand stairway, and a plain iron door to the east
gives on the slave cells. The hall stretches on north toward the altar.

5142.name: The Grand Temple Of Lloth

north.description: A passage leads to The Altar

south.description: A passage leads to The Main Chamber

5142.description:
Deeper in the temple the webs grow thicker, draped from pillar to pillar
in great pale sheets that stir though no breath of air can be felt. The
floor is cold black stone, stained dark in long trails that lead north
toward the altar. A heavy, coppery smell hangs everywhere, and the
silence is so deep that every footstep seems an intrusion. Back to the
south the hall opens toward the golden doors.

5145.name: The Horrible Bloodstained Altar
5145.description:
This is front of a highly and freshly bloodstained altar. Engraved on
the top of the altar is a giant spider with a human head. Looking down
from the altar you see a large sacrificial pit with thousands of
swarming spiders looking for their next meal! The walls are rough-hewn
and cold to the touch. Shadows gather in the corners.

north.description: A passage leads to The Dias

5146.name: Slave Cells
5146.description:
This is the main room to the cell chambers for the slaves to be
sacrificed. You notice there are no guards around. The walls are rough-
hewn and cold to the touch. The air is still and musty.

north.description: A passage leads to The Slave Pen

west.description: To the west lies The Grand Temple Of Lloth.

5147.name: Slave Pen
5147.description:
Rotten meat and breads lie about the floor while shackles hang from the
walls. The room reeks of death. You almost become nauseous and decide to
leave the room since you were obviously too late to save the slave. The
walls are rough-hewn and cold to the touch. The ceiling hangs low
overhead.

south.description: A passage leads to The Slave Cells

5148.name: The Bloodstained Dais

south.description: A passage leads to The Altar

west.description: A passage leads to The Treasury

5148.description:
The dais rises behind the altar on a broad platform of black stone, its
surface splashed and crusted with old blood. Cold silver chains hang
from rings set into the floor, and a carved spider of jet crouches at
its back, legs spread wide over the whole platform. A narrow door in the
west wall leads into the treasury. Back to the south lies the
bloodstained altar itself.

extra_descs.jet spider carving:
The spider is carved from a single great block of polished jet, its body
as large as an ox. Old blood has run into the grooves of its legs and
dried there black.

5149.name: The Drow Treasury
5149.description:
This is obviously only a temporary storage place for the collected
treasure being rather bare. Dust motes drift in the stale air. Shadows
gather in the corners.

east.description: A passage leads to The Dias

205150.name: A Bend In The City Street

north.description: To the north lies The City Street.

east.description: To the east lies The City Street Outside The Adamantium gates.

west.description: To the west lies The Fungus Forest.

205150.description:
The city street bends sharply here around the foot of a great stalagmite
whose base has been left uncarved. To the west a low door of woven iron
opens onto the Fungus Forest, and its damp, earthy smell drifts out to
mingle with the stale air. The street runs north deeper into the city
and east toward the adamantium gates. Faint violet light glows from
carvings set along the kerb.

5151.name: A Damp Alcove

north.description: To the north lies A Dark Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Rocky Shore.

5151.description:
This damp alcove sits just inside the cliff face, its walls running with
water and its floor slick with green weed. Salt air blows in from the
south, where a gap in the rock opens onto a rocky shore and the grey sea
beyond. A plank door to the north leads into a dark tunnel. The roar of
the surf echoes strangely in the narrow space.

5152.name: A Dark Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Dark Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Damp Alcove.

5152.description:
The dark tunnel ends against a wall of wet rock, where a crude door of
driftwood planks lashed together with rope is set in the stone to the
south. Beyond it comes the faint, distant sound of waves and a smell of
salt. The tunnel runs back east. Moss grows thick along the foot of the
walls.

5153.name: A Dark Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Dark Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Dark Tunnel.

5153.description:
The tunnel turns here, and a trickle of water runs across the floor from
a crack in the wall, pooling in a shallow hollow. The rock is softer
here and has been worn into odd, smooth shapes. The way leads north and
west, the air growing damper toward the west. Small pale crystals glint
where the water has dried.

5154.name: A Dark Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Dark Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Dark Tunnel.

5154.description:
The tunnel runs straight and narrow here through black rock that seems
to drink what little light there is. The ceiling is low enough to brush
the head of a tall traveller. Faint scratches on the walls might be the
marks of claws or of tools. The passage leads north and south.

5155.name: A Dark Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Smelly Cave.

east.description: To the east lies A Sharply Sloping Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Dark Tunnel.

5155.description:
The dark tunnel meets a crossing here, and a foul stench drifts from a
cave to the north. To the east a door of rough timber closes off a
sharply sloping passage, and the tunnel runs on south into the dark. The
walls are black with soot from ancient fires. No light reaches here at
all.

5156.name: A Smelly Cave

south.description: To the south lies A Dark Tunnel.

5156.description:
The stench in this low cave is overwhelming, a thick reek of rot, dung
and stale smoke. The floor is covered in filthy straw and gnawed scraps,
and the rock is smeared with crude marks in mud and ash. It is the sort
of place where something lives and does not care how. The only way out
is south, back into the dark tunnel.

5157.name: A Sharply Sloping Tunnel

west.description: To the west lies A Dark Tunnel.

down.description: To the down lies A Narrow Ledge.

5157.description:
This tunnel slopes so sharply that the floor is almost a stair, and the
rock is polished slick where countless hands and feet have scrabbled for
purchase. At the bottom the passage drops down onto a narrow ledge. At
the top a door of rough timber bound with iron is set into the west
wall. The walls press close on every side.

5158.name: A Narrow Ledge

east.description: To the east lies A Narrow Ledge.

up.description: To the up lies A Sharply Sloping Tunnel.

5158.description:
The ledge ends here against a jutting buttress of rock, and a steep
crack climbs up into a sloping tunnel overhead. Handholds have been worn
into the stone by many climbers before you. The ledge runs back east
along the cliff face. A faint breath of cooler air drifts down through
the crack.

5159.name: A Narrow Ledge

west.description: To the west lies A Narrow Ledge.

down.description: To the down lies A Wider Tunnel.

5159.description:
A narrow ledge runs along the face of a sheer cliff here, so slim that
one must press against the rock to pass. A crumbling slope leads down to
the wider tunnel. The ledge creeps on west along the wall, and the drop
beside it falls away into black emptiness. Loose stones shift underfoot
with every step.

5160.name: A Wider Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Wide Tunnel.

up.description: To the up lies A Narrow Ledge.

5160.description:
The tunnel widens into a broad gallery of rough rock, its floor uneven
and its ceiling scarred by old falls. At one side a crumbling slope of
stone leads up toward a narrow ledge high on the wall. The way north
leads back into the wide tunnel. A distant rumble sometimes shakes fine
dust from overhead.

5161.name: A Wide Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Wide Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Wider Tunnel.

5161.description:
Here the wide tunnel is crossed by a narrow seam of pale crystal that
glints in the faintest light. Someone once tried to cut it out of the
rock, and the scars of their chisels are still plain in the wall. The
tunnel runs east and turns south, where it grows broader still. The air
is cool and very still.

5162.name: A Wide Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Wide Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Wide Tunnel.

5162.description:
The tunnel turns here around a great boulder that has fallen from the
ceiling and been left where it lay. The rock overhead is cracked and
sagging. The passage runs north, and to the west it squeezes round the
boulder and goes on. Water trickles down one wall in a thin, glittering
sheet.

5163.name: A Wide Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies A Wide Tunnel.

down.description: To the down lies A Wide Tunnel.

5163.description:
The wide tunnel levels out at the top of a steep rise, and the rough
steps lead back down into the darkness. Old torch brackets, long rusted,
are set into the walls at intervals, though no light has burned in them
for an age. The tunnel runs on south, its floor scattered with gravel. A
faint smell of smoke hangs in the air, old and stale.

5164.name: A Wide Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Tunnel.

up.description: To the up lies A Wide Tunnel.

5164.description:
A wide tunnel runs through the rock here, broad enough for a cart, its
floor worn smooth by the passage of many feet over long ages. At this
end the floor rises steeply, and a slope of rough steps leads up into
the dark. The tunnel runs back east to a bend. The walls are cold and
slick with damp.

5165.name: A Bend In The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Large Cave.

south.description: To the south lies The Secret Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Wide Tunnel.

5165.description:
The tunnel bends here where three ways meet in the rough rock. To the
north the passage opens into a large cave, a wide tunnel runs off west
into the dark, and to the south a slab that looks like the wall itself
hides a door. The floor is gritty with fallen stone, and a cold draught
comes and goes.

5166.name: The Large Cave

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Tunnel.

5166.description:
The tunnel opens into a large cave, its roof lost in darkness and hung
with long stalactites that drip slowly onto the stone. Broken
stalagmites stand about the floor like the stumps of a felled forest. A
shallow pool lies in one hollow, black and perfectly still. The only way
out lies back south to the bend in the tunnel.

5167.name: The Secret Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Bend In The Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Secret Tunnel.

5167.description:
The secret tunnel turns here, and a heavy slab of stone hangs in a
groove at its northern end, a hidden door that can be slid aside. Dust
lies thick on the floor, marked only by a narrow worn path. The passage
runs back east toward the glowing chamber. Water drips somewhere in the
dark, slow and steady.

5168.name: A Secret Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Small Glowing Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Secret Tunnel.

5168.description:
This tunnel is low and narrow, hidden behind a door of stone made to
look like the rock around it. Its walls are rough and unworked, bearing
only the marks of crude tools. The air is still and stale, and the only
light is a faint green glow leaking from the chamber to the east. The
passage leads on west into the darkness.

5169.name: A Small Glowing Chamber

north.description: To the north lies A Thin Underground Bridge.

west.description: To the west lies A Secret Tunnel.

5169.description:
This small chamber is hollowed out of the chasm wall and lit by a thick
carpet of glowing fungus that covers its floor and walls in soft green
light. The air is warm and damp and smells of mould. A door to the north
leads out onto the thin bridge, and a low gap in the west wall opens
into a hidden tunnel. Carvings of open eyes have been cut above both
openings.

5170.name: A Thin Underground Bridge

north.description: To the north lies A Thin Underground Bridge.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Glowing Chamber.

5170.description:
The bridge narrows here until it is barely a hand's width wider than a
boot, and the rock beneath it is cracked. Ahead to the south a soft
green glow spills from an opening in the chasm wall where the bridge
ends. Back north the span climbs gently toward the slab where the
bridges meet. The drop on both sides is utterly black.

5171.name: A Thin Underground Bridge

east.description: To the east lies A Thin Underground Bridge.

5171.description:
This thin bridge runs only a short way from the slab before it ends
against the sheer chasm wall. A doorway was carved there once, framed
with spiders, but it has been sealed with a slab of stone fused smooth
as glass. The way back lies east to where the bridges meet. A soft, cold
wind blows up from the depths, carrying a faint smell of water.

5172.name: A Thin Underground Bridge

east.description: To the east lies A Thin Underground Bridge.

south.description: To the south lies A Thin Underground Bridge.

west.description: To the west lies A Thin Underground Bridge.

5172.description:
Another meeting of bridges lies here, where three spans join on a broad
slab of rock wedged across the chasm. The slab tilts slightly, enough to
make every step uncertain. Spans lead east, west and south, each
vanishing into the dark after a few paces. Someone has scratched a small
mark into the stone, an arrow pointing south.

extra_descs.mark arrow scratch:
The arrow is scratched shallow and quick, by a blade point rather than a
tool. It points along the south span, and beside it someone has added a
tiny drawn eye.

5173.name: A Thin Underground Bridge

north.description: To the north lies A Thin Underground Bridge.

west.description: To the west lies A Thin Underground Bridge.

5173.description:
The bridge bends here around a column of rock, its surface slick with
moisture that drips from somewhere far overhead. Small patches of
glowing fungus cling to the column, giving just enough light to see the
edge. The span runs north to the meeting of the bridges and west along
the chasm wall. Far below, a faint gleam of water may be a river or only
a trick of the eyes.

5174.name: A Thin Underground Bridge

north.description: To the north lies A Thin Underground Bridge.

south.description: To the south lies A Thin Underground Bridge.

west.description: To the west lies A Thin Underground Bridge.

5174.description:
Three thin bridges meet here on a narrow pillar of rock that rises from
the depths of the chasm. One runs north to a dead end in the dark, one
south deeper into the maze of spans, and one back west toward the
arches. The pillar's top is flat and barely three paces across. Strands
of old web stretch between the bridges, glistening faintly.

5175.name: A Thin Underground Bridge

south.description: To the south lies A Thin Underground Bridge.

5175.description:
The bridge simply stops here, its end broken off jaggedly above the
void. Whatever it once reached has long since fallen into the chasm, and
only a stump of carved stone juts from the far wall, out of reach across
the dark. Pebbles kicked from the edge fall without a sound. The only
way is back south along the span.

5176.name: A Thin Underground Bridge

east.description: To the east lies A Thin Underground Bridge.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel Of Ornate Arches.

5176.description:
A thin bridge of stone springs out over a bottomless chasm, barely wide
enough for one to walk upon. There is no rail, only a low lip of carved
stone on either side, and the darkness beneath swallows every sound.
Behind, to the west, a door leads back into the tunnel of arches. The
bridge reaches on east into the gloom.

5177.name: The Tunnel Of Ornate Arches

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel Of Ornate Arches.

east.description: To the east lies A Thin Underground Bridge.

5177.description:
The last of the ornate arches stands here, larger than the rest and
carved with a great spider whose spread legs frame the passage. Beyond
it the worked stone gives way to the raw rock of a chasm, and a thin
bridge reaches out across the dark to the east. The tunnel runs back
north under its row of lit arches. A cold wind rises from the depths and
moans softly through the carvings.

5178.name: The Tunnel Of Ornate Arches

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel Of Ornate Arches.

west.description: To the west lies At The Adamantium Gates.

5178.description:
A long tunnel leads away from the gates beneath a series of graceful
arches, each carved from the living rock and worked with spiders, webs
and twining vines. Faint faerie fire glows along the keystones, making a
path of violet lights. The floor is smooth and swept clean of every
pebble. The tunnel turns south here, and back to the west lie the
adamantium gates.

5179.name: The Entrance To The First House

east.description: To the east lies The City Street Outside The First House.

up.description: To the up lies The Main Chamber Of The First House.

5179.description:
The entrance hall of the First House is cold and lofty, lined with
columns carved to look like pillars wrapped in web. Banners of black
silk embroidered with the house's spider sigil hang motionless from the
high ceiling. A grand stair of polished obsidian climbs up toward the
main chamber. Through the open doors to the east the violet glow of the
street seeps in across the floor.

5180.name: The Entrance To The Fourth House

south.description: To the south lies The City Street Outside The Fourth House.

up.description: To the up lies The Main Chamber In The Fourth house.

5180.description:
Bare walls of grey stone and a low ceiling give the entrance of the
Fourth House a cramped, guarded feel. Arrow slits are cut into the walls
on either side, looking out over the doorway to the south. A tight
spiral stair rises up into the main chamber of the house. A single lamp
of glowing fungus hangs from a chain, casting a cold blue light over the
bare floor.

5181.name: The Entrance To The Third House

south.description: To the south lies The City Street Outside The Third House.

up.description: To the up lies The Main Chamber In The Third House.

5181.description:
The entrance hall of the Third House is narrow and high, cut straight
into the living stalagmite so that its walls curve inward as they climb.
A spiral of shallow steps winds up along the wall toward the main
chamber above. The floor is polished black stone set with the crest of a
spider clutching a crescent moon. Through the doorway to the south the
street lies in its violet gloom.

5182.name: The Entrance To The Second House

south.description: To the south lies The City Street Outside The Second House.

up.description: To the up lies The Main Chamber In The Second House.

5182.description:
Cool air moves softly through this entrance hall, drawn in from the
street to the south and up through the spires above. The walls are
carved with a frieze of armed figures standing shoulder to shoulder,
their stone faces cruelly fine, their eyes set with chips of red garnet.
A broad stair of black stone climbs up into the main chamber of the
house. Small niches along the walls hold glowing fungus in silver cups.

5110.name: The Center Of The Drow City

north.description: To the north lies The City Street.

east.description: To the east lies The City Street.

south.description: A passage leads to A City Street

west.description: To the west lies The City Street.

5110.description:
The four great streets of the city meet here in a wide round plaza paved
with black flagstones, each one inlaid with a thin thread of silver. At
its middle rises a slender pillar of carved stone, its whole length
worked into climbing spiders and coiling script, and a faint violet fire
crawls over its tip without ever burning down. Streets leave the plaza
north, east, south and west between towering stalagmite houses. Far
overhead the cavern roof is lost in darkness, and the silence presses
like the weight of the rock itself.

extra_descs.pillar carved stone spiders script:
The pillar is no thicker than a drow's waist yet rises higher than a
house. Spiders of every size climb its length among lines of angular
script praising the Spider Queen, and the violet flame at its tip
flickers as if to mark the passing hours.

5184.name: The Fungus Forest

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The City Street.

5184.description:
Giant mushrooms rise here like trees, their pale stalks thick as pillars
and their wide caps glowing in soft shades of blue and violet. Spores
drift slowly in the still air, catching the light like motes of dust.
The ground is soft and spongy underfoot, carpeted with smaller fungi
that crunch with every step. A low iron door to the east leads back to a
bend in the city street.

5185.name: A Small Dwelling In The Stalagmite

east.description: To the east lies The City Street.

5185.description:
This dwelling is hollowed from a stalagmite of reddish stone, unusual
among the black spires of the city. Its single room is bare but for a
stone bench and a few hooks on the wall, where a cloak or a lantern
might hang. A small window, no more than a slit, lets in a sliver of
violet light. The doorway east leads back to the city street.

5186.name: A Small Dwelling In The Stalagmite

west.description: To the west lies The City Street.

5186.description:
The hollowed stalagmite makes a snug, low-ceilinged home, its walls
painted with faded scenes of the cavern's bridges and spires. A cold
hearth stands in a niche, its stone blackened by years of small fires. A
curtain of grey cloth hangs across a sleeping alcove, and a rack of
drying fungus fills one corner with an earthy smell. The doorway west
leads out to the city street.

5187.name: A Small Dwelling In The Stalactite

east.description: To the east lies The City Street.

5187.description:
This home is carved into the tip of a great stalactite that hangs from
the cavern roof until its point nearly touches the street. The room is
shaped like an upturned cone, wide overhead and narrow at the floor, and
its walls weep slowly with water that is caught in a stone basin. A
hammock of woven silk is slung across the space. The doorway opens east
onto the city street.

5188.name: A Small Dwelling In The Stalagmite

north.description: To the north lies The City Street.

5188.description:
This small home is hollowed from the base of a stalagmite, its single
round room no more than a few paces across. A sleeping mat of woven
fungus fibre lies against the curving wall, beside a low stone table and
a shelf of plain clay bowls. The ceiling narrows to a point where the
stone has been left rough. The doorway to the north opens onto the city
street.

5189.name: A Small Dwelling In The Stalagmite

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The City Street.

5189.description:
The inside of this stalagmite has been carved into a neat little home,
its walls polished smooth and set with tiny niches for candles. A low
bed of carved stone stands against the far wall, covered with a coarse
grey blanket. Bundles of dried fungus hang from the ceiling, giving off
a musty smell. The doorway to the east opens onto a bend in the city
street.

5190.name: The Forge

east.description: To the east lies The City Street.

5190.description:
This forge is older and rougher than its neighbour across the street,
its hearth hollowed from the raw rock and blackened by centuries of
smoke. A wide stone trough of oily quenching water stands beside the
anvil, steaming faintly. Tongs and hammers hang from hooks along the
walls, each shaped with a care that makes even tools look like
jewellery. The street lies through the doorway to the east.

5191.name: The Forge

west.description: To the west lies The City Street.

5191.description:
Heat rolls from a great forge set into the back of this low workshop,
its coals glowing a deep violet rather than red. Iron racks along the
walls stand ready for slim curved blades, hooked spears and coats of
fine mail. An anvil of black iron sits before the hearth, its face
polished bright by long use. The doorway west opens back onto the city
street.

5192.name: An Ornate Walkway High Above The City

east.description: To the east lies An Ornate Walkway High Above The City.

west.description: To the west lies The First Throne.

5192.description:
This slender walkway of carved stone arches out from the First House
across empty air, no wider than two people walking abreast. Its
balustrade is a lace of interwoven webs cut so finely that the violet
light below shines through it. Far beneath, the streets of the city wind
between the stalagmite houses like threads of glowing fungus. The
walkway runs on east, and a door to the west leads back into the First
Throne.

5193.name: An Ornate Walkway High Above The City

east.description: To the east lies Entrance To The Temple Of Lloth.

west.description: To the west lies An Ornate Walkway High Above The City.

5193.description:
The ornate walkway bends here as it nears the great temple, and the
stone underfoot is worn into a shallow groove by generations of passing
feet. Ahead to the east a towering door of gold and adamantite opens
onto the temple entrance. The drop on either side is dizzying, and a
faint cold draught rises from the city far below. The walkway stretches
back west toward the First House.

5194.name: The City Street

north.description: To the north lies A Junction In The City Street.

east.description: To the east lies The Forge.

south.description: To the south lies The Center Of The Drow City.

west.description: To the west lies The Forge.

5194.description:
Forges stand on either side of this stretch of street, and the clang of
hammers rings from the doorways east and west. The black flagstones here
are scored and pitted where heavy loads of iron have been dragged along.
Warm air spills from both smithies, smelling of hot metal and coal
smoke, a strange thing in the cold stillness of the cavern. The street
runs north to a junction and south to the centre of the city.

5195.name: A Junction In The City Street

east.description: To the east lies The City Street Outside The Third House.

south.description: To the south lies The City Street.

west.description: To the west lies The City Street Outside The Second House.

5195.description:
Here the street splits beneath a carved archway of pale stone, its arc
lined with the sigils of the noble houses. One way leads east past the
gates of the Third House, the other west toward the Second. Behind, to
the south, the road returns to the forges and the heart of the city.
Glowing fungus has been coaxed into narrow beds along the kerbs, and its
cold blue light pools on the paving like spilled water.

5196.name: The City Street Outside The Second House

north.description: To the north lies The Entrance To The Second House.

east.description: To the east lies A Junction In The City Street.

west.description: To the west lies The City Street Outside The First House.

5196.description:
The Second House rises to the north, a cluster of three stalagmites
joined by slender bridges of carved stone, each spire pierced by dozens
of tiny lit windows. Its doorway is a tall slit framed in adamantite,
cold and grey. The paving of the street is laid in a pattern of
interlocking webs, worn smooth by countless feet. Westward lies the
grander seat of the First House, and the junction is back to the east.

5197.name: The City Street Outside The First House

east.description: To the east lies The City Street Outside The Second House.

west.description: To the west lies The Entrance To The First House.

5197.description:
The street widens here into a broad forecourt before the greatest house
in the city. The First House rises as a forest of carved stalagmites, so
thickly worked with balconies, spires and lace-fine stone that it seems
grown rather than built. Its great doorway lies to the west, guarded by
a pair of tall adamantite doors left standing open. To the east the
street runs back past the Second House.

5198.name: The City Street

east.description: To the east lies The City Street Outside The Fourth House.

west.description: To the west lies The Center Of The Drow City.

5198.description:
The city street runs straight here between rows of slender stalagmite
homes, their doorways sealed with screens of carved stone. Faint violet
faerie fire outlines the rooftops, and here and there a lamp of glowing
fungus hangs from an iron bracket. The paving is smooth and spotless,
swept clean by unseen hands. Westward the street opens into the great
plaza at the city's centre, and eastward it leads on toward the Fourth
House.

5199.name: The City Street Outside The Fourth House

north.description: To the north lies The Entrance To The Fourth House.

east.description: To the east lies The Mages' Academy.

west.description: To the west lies The City Street.

5199.description:
Two buildings face each other across this stretch of street. To the
north stands the Fourth House, a squat, heavy stalagmite whose door is
barred with bands of black iron, and to the east a tall, narrow tower
carved with arcane runes houses the Mages' Academy behind a door of dark
crystal. The runes pulse slowly with a soft violet light. The street
runs back west toward the centre of the city.

5115.name: A City Street
5115.description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street leading south. A building is
to the west. Dust motes drift in the stale air. The walls are rough-hewn
and cold to the touch.

west.description: A passage leads to The Clerics' Academy

north.description: To the north lies The City Street.

5116.name: The Clerics' Academy
5116.description:
This is the most lavish of the academies being that it is for the
clerics. The ceiling hangs low overhead. Shadows gather in the corners.
The air is stale and the walls close. Shadows pool in the corners,
undisturbed.

east.description: A passage leads to A City Street

5100.name: goblin
5100.long_desc: A goblin slave lies here asleep.
5100.description: The defenseless goblin begs for mercy.

5101.name: drow
5101.long_desc: A drow commoner is here, walking around on guard duty.
5101.description: I doubt he is the type to give directions.

5102.name: drow
5102.long_desc: A drow warrior stands here guarding his home.

5103.name: drow
5103.long_desc: A drow mage is here protecting his home.
5103.description: The mage prepares to cast a spell... at you!!

5104.name: drow
5104.long_desc: A drow priestess is here shouting orders.
5104.description: I wouldn't want go get on her bad side!

5105.name: drow
5105.long_desc: A drow master stares at you angrily.
5105.description: The drow master is ALWAYS ready for a fight.

5106.name: drow
5106.long_desc: A drow weaponsmaster is here shadow boxing.
5106.description: He definitely know his way around in combat.

5107.name: drow
5107.long_desc: The Matron Mother of the house is standing here.
5107.description: She looks really and truly annoyed that you have found your way here.

5108.name: drow
5108.long_desc: The Matron Mother of the first house is waiting for you.
5108.description: She looks like she is about to rip your head of and eat it.

5109.name: drider
5109.long_desc: The drider looks at you viciously while it draws its sword.
5109.description: This half-spider, half-drow creature is a formidable opponent.

5110.name: drider
5110.long_desc: The drider looks at you viciously while it draws its sword.
5110.description: This half-spider, half-drow creature is a formidable opponent.

5111.name: yochlol
5111.long_desc: A yochlol forms out of a swirling mist...
5111.description: The yochlol is not in a good mood.

5100.name: longsword
5100.room_desc: A commoner's longsword made of adamantite has been left here.

5101.name: longsword
5101.room_desc: A drow noble's longsword, made of adamantite, lies here.

5102.name: whip
5102.room_desc: A whip with two snakes heads lies here.

5103.name: whip
5103.room_desc: A whip with three snake heads has been left here.

5104.name: whip
5104.room_desc: A whip with four snake heads has been carelessly left here.

5105.name: longsword
5105.room_desc: A black longsword has been carelessly left here.

5107.name: whip
5107.room_desc: A whip with six snake heads has been dropped here very carelessly.

5108.name: bracers
5108.room_desc: A pair of iron bracers has been dropped here.

5109.name: gauntlets
5109.room_desc: A pair of gauntlets is lying on the ground.

5110.name: wand
5110.room_desc: A silvery blue wand has been dropped in the dirt.

5111.name: helmet
5111.room_desc: A small helmet lies up against a rock.

5112.name: ring
5112.room_desc: A small ruby ring lies in the dirt.

5113.name: dagger
5113.room_desc: A dagger with spider leg shaped blades lies on the ground.

5114.name: hat
5114.room_desc: A small bright green hat lies in the dirt.

5115.name: key
5115.room_desc: A key made of a strange metal is lying here.

5116.name: gold
5116.room_desc: A large pile of golden coins is lying here.

5120.name: shadow priory reliquary
5120.room_desc: A shadow priory reliquary lies here.

5151.name: drow shadow armor
5151.room_desc: Dark armor radiating shadow lies here.
5151.description: Armor woven from drow silk and shadow.

5152.name: drow shadow cloak
5152.room_desc: A cloak of living shadow lies here.

5153.name: drow shadow blade
5153.room_desc: A black blade pulses with shadow.

5154.name: drow shadow ring
5154.room_desc: A ring of darkness lies here.
